digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI (+ Mgombato bunduchi)
other_mijikenda: Duruma, Swahili: same name 'Mbunduchi' (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: The 'gun' shrub: Digo children load its small round fruits as bullets in their toy guns.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha 'bunduki': watoto wa Kidigo hutumia matunda yake madogo ya mviringo kama risasi za bunduki zao za kuchezea.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha 'bunduchi': ana a Chidigo nkuhumira matunda madide ga duara dza risasi za bunduchi zao za kuchezera.

summary.en: Mbunduchi is a shrub with clusters of small white flowers and round fruits. Children use the fruits as ammunition in toy guns, which gave it its name.
summary.sw: Mbunduchi ni kichaka chenye vishada vya maua madogo meupe na matunda ya mviringo. Watoto hutumia matunda yake kama risasi za bunduki za kuchezea, na ndiyo asili ya jina lake.
summary.dg: *Mbunduchi* ni chitsaka chenye mabunda ga maruwa madide mereru na matunda ga duara. Ana nkuhumira matundage dza risasi za bunduchi za kuchezera, na kpwa hivyo mmea hinyu ukaphaha dzinare.

about.en: Mbunduchi is a shrub or small tree with alternate, simple leaves. Small, white, often fragrant flowers grow in loose clusters at the ends of the shoots. They are followed by small, round, fleshy fruits that ripen orange to red, each about the size of a pea. Digo people identify it by its leaves and fruits.
about.sw: Mbunduchi ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani sahili yanayopishana. Maua madogo meupe, mara nyingi yenye harufu nzuri, huota katika vishada vilivyolegea kwenye ncha za machipukizi. Hufuatwa na matunda madogo ya mviringo yenye nyama, yanayoiva yakawa ya machungwa hadi mekundu, kila moja likiwa na ukubwa wa punje ya njegere. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg: *Mbunduchi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ga kawaida, ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kupishana. Maruwa madide mereru, mara nyinji ga arufu nono, ganamera kpwa mabunda ga kutawanyika kpwenye ntsa za maphungo. Badaye ganalavya matunda madide ga duara genye nyama, ganayoiva na kukala rangi ya chungbwa hadi ya kundu; chila rimwenga ni dza tembe ya mbalazi. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na matundage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and dry forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani, vichaka na misitu mikavu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani, vitsakani na matsakani makavu.

uses.en: The fruits are used by children as 'bullets' in toy guns.
uses.sw: Matunda yake hutumiwa na watoto kama 'risasi' katika bunduki za kuchezea.
uses.dg: Ana nkuhumira matundage dza 'risasi' za bunduchi zao za kuchezera.

culture.en: This is one of the few Digo plant names that comes from children's play. Pakia explains *mbunduchi* as 'gun', because the fruits are used as bullets in toy guns (*bunduchi*). Mgombato gives *bunduchi* as gun (Swahili *bunduki*). Pakia records that the name is shared with Duruma and Swahili.
culture.sw: Hili ni mojawapo ya majina machache ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayotokana na michezo ya watoto. Pakia anaeleza *mbunduchi* kuwa 'bunduki', kwa sababu matunda yake hutumika kama risasi katika bunduki za kuchezea (*bunduchi*). Mgombato anatoa *bunduchi* kwa maana ya bunduki (Kiswahili *bunduki*). Pakia anarekodi kwamba jina hili linashirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kiswahili.
culture.dg: Hiri ni dzina mwenga kahi ya madzina machache ga mimea ga Chidigo garigolavywa kula michezo ya ana. Pakia anaeleza *mbunduchi* kukala ni 'bunduchi', kpwa sababu matundage nkuhumirwa dza risasi za bunduchi za kuchezera (*bunduchi*). Mgombato unapha *bunduchi* dza mana ya bunduchi (Chiswahili *bunduki*). Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri ni ra Chiduruma na Chiswahili piya.

names.en: Digo: *mbunduchi*, 'gun'. Pakia's Appendix III also gives *mfyofyo* for this species. That name is also used for two shrubs of the coffee family, *Feretia apodanthera* and *Heinsia crinita*. A related species, *Bourreria teitensis*, is called *mvundza jembe*. No English name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbunduchi*, 'bunduki'. Kiambatisho III cha Pakia pia kinatoa *mfyofyo* kwa spishi hii. Jina hilo pia hutumika kwa vichaka viwili vya familia ya mibuni (kahawa), *Feretia apodanthera* na *Heinsia crinita*. Spishi jamaa yake, *Bourreria teitensis*, huitwa *mvundza jembe*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbunduchi*, 'bunduchi'. Chitabu cha Pakia, *Appendix III*, chinapha piya *mfyofyo* kpwa aina hino. Dzina hiro piya nkuhumirwa kpwa vitsaka viiri vya jamii ya kahawa, *Feretia apodanthera* na *Heinsia crinita*. Aina ya phephi, *Bourreria teitensis*, inaihwa *mvundza jembe*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.
